The Modern British Literature Index

By Roger Blackwell Bailey, Ph.D.

Nurse Edith Cavell, 1865 - 1915

The horrors of war have cast their pall over  the twentieth century and not least so the  ghastly Great War, that destroyed what  was  left of Victorian optimism and hope for human perfectability. Among the atrocities of that war was the murder by firing squad, in Belgium, of the British Nurse Edith Cavell by Kaiser Wilhelm II's barbarians. She is buried in a simple grave just outside Norwich Cathedral.
